Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
The Admonitions [BH:U, Third:U]
Cardtype: Master
Unique master.
Put this card in play. Tap to discard one card if you control a ready
Sabbat vampire. *Tap to draw two cards if you control a ready Black
Hand vampire.* During your discard phase, control of The Admonitions
passes counter-clockwise until it is controlled by a Methuselah who
controls a ready Sabbat vampire (or is burned if there are none).

Text highlight by me

The above card does no follow the standard "discard down to your hand
size" formulation. Is there a reason for this?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Space. Reminder text is a candidate for elimination when card space limits are
exceeded. It also lacks the "draw up to your hand size afterward" reminder for
the Sabbat-keyed discard.
